fact: Car 11 was out of position at the start of the race, taking the vacant position left by Car 5 which started in the pit lane.
offence: Breach of Article B5.11.1 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. Car 11 started from position 16 instead of position 18. In Monaco, two places on the grid is a very significant advantage. Therefore the penalty needs to reflect this, when compared to other false start incidents including being in the wrong position at other tracks where the advantage may not have been as significant.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 11 False Start Out Of Position
to: The Team Manager, Cadillac Formula 1 Team
